newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's INA to report improved '96 results.
newsitem.headline: Italy's INA to report improved '96 results.

text.p: Italian insurer Ina expects to report improved results for 1996 after "excellent" growth, the group's managing director Giancarlo Giannini told a news conference.
"Ina had excellent product growth, notwithstanding that our sales channel is a network of agencies. (Ina unit) Assitalia achieved an improvement in technical results in 1996 as well," he said.

"In 1996 there will be an improvement in respect to 1995, even though two years ago there was an exceptional increase in the subscriptions of life policies due to measures in the (government's) budget," he added.
It is not known when Ina will report 1996 results but generally Italian insurers release preliminary data in April and May.
